title: Adaptive Envelope Introspector and Schema Confidence Scorer
creator: Jordan Kim
description: Introduce a lightweight middleware (Envelope Introspector) in the usage ingestion pipeline that computes a per-event schema confidence score, annotates events with provenance and confidence metadata, and surfaces aggregate signals to Console dashboards. The scorer should be adaptive: it combines fast syntactic checks, feature-based heuristics, and a small ML-based model run in a low-latency path for ambiguous cases. The goal is to improve downstream analytics quality, enable smarter sampling/backfills, and reduce noisy schema regression alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Envelope Introspector deployed to staging and processing 100% of test traffic without >1% latency regression at p99
Each event receives a 'schema_confidence' numeric tag (0.0-1.0) and a 'confidence_reason' short enum when confidence < 0.85
Console dashboard shows hourly distribution of schema_confidence and top 10 low-confidence signatures
Sampling policy honors confidence tags: low-confidence events flagged for 100% retention for 24 hours; high-confidence events sampled at 10%
Retrospective backfill tooling can re-run scorer over 30 days of archived events and produce diff reports
technical_notes: Runtime integration point: ingress pre-transform stage in usage-ingest lambda/consumer (nginx->kafka consumer path)

Confidence pipeline: 1) fast JSON shape checks against canonical registry, 2) heuristic rules (missing fields, type mismatches, enum deviations), 3) lightweight classifier (Featurized logistic model) for ties
Model runtime constraint: p50 < 0.8ms, p99 < 6ms when batched at 64. Fallback to heuristics if model unavailable.
Metadata schema: add fields 'schema_confidence' (float), 'confidence_reason' (string), 'introspector_version' (string), 'introspector_trace_id' (string) to event envelope; ensure no PII introduced
Storage: low-confidence event fingerprints are routed to 'ingest-low-confidence' Kafka topic for separate retention and manual review
Metrics: expose 'introspector.latency', 'introspector.confidence_distribution', 'introspector.skipped_due_to_rate' to Grafana via Prometheus
testing_plan: Unit tests for rules and scorer: validate known-good/known-bad fixtures
Performance benchmarks on staging cluster with synthetic traffic replicating 1k rps; collect p50/p95/p99 latency
A/B staging rollout: 10% traffic on introspector v1 for 72h, validate no spike in error budget
Chaos test: simulate model endpoint failure and ensure heuristics path keeps p99 within SLO
E2E: verify sampling policy behavior and backfill produce identical confidence tags when reprocessed
rollout_plan: Feature branch -> PR -> merge. Initial canary: 1% of traffic for 24h (console-qa org)
Increase to 10% for 72h, monitor dashboards and p99 latency and Console alerts
If metrics stable, ramp to 50% then 100% over 48h windows. Post-ramp run a 7-day regression check for analytics deltas
Enable retrospective backfill as an opt-in job guarded by throttles and cost budget
risks_mitigation: Risk: Added per-event processing could increase p99 latency. Mitigation: fastpath heuristics and model fallback, strict CPU cgroup for scorer, and circuit-breaker to bypass introspector under load
Risk: False positives from scorer increase noise. Mitigation: conservative default thresholds, feedback loop to update heuristics, manual review queue for analyst triage
Risk: Privacy exposure by adding fields. Mitigation: design review with Privacy & Security, strip any user-identifying fields from introspector traces, and use only fingerprints/hashes where needed
